# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Uno modernization and platform compatibility**

## Highlights

Upcoming changes modernize Uno integration and correct native interop, rendering, and stream-lifetime behavior. This post-preview work raises Apple deployment requirements and updates Windows integration. It also paces automatic Android texture rendering to the display clock and fixes Linux HarfBuzz symbol conflicts.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Uno integrations to Uno Platform 7** — Non-Windows Uno views require Uno 7 and .NET 10; pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are no longer supported. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, renders through a CPU fallback, reports null GRContext, and drops RaiseOnUnsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering and the .NET SDK WASM pipeline. Windows package facades retain the WinAppSDK control. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Respect the raised Apple deployment minimums** — Native libraries now require macOS 11 or iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS/tvOS minimums rise to 14; managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 requirements remain higher and unchanged. Raise application deployment targets as needed and honor the highest requirement in the application stack. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Keep SKData.CreateCopy lengths within the source array** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source buffer instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Pass one encoded unit to character-code conversion** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates the encoded byte width rather than UTF-16 string length. Pass one code unit for the selected encoding; use Utf32 for supplementary characters. Invalid multi-unit input is rejected with ArgumentException. GetString(byte[], SKTextEncoding) now reports ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException for null data. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Use rebuilt Graphite-enabled WebGPU archives** — emdawnwebgpu C++ support now ships inside libSkiaSharp.a instead of compiling on the application's final link line. Use matching rebuilt Graphite-enabled archives; pre-change archives and GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy the new link contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is retained. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Bug Fixes

- **Android continuous frames follow display refresh** — Automatic GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows Choreographer pulses instead of buffer-swap throughput. Painting remains on the GL worker; explicit render requests and synchronous lifecycle progress remain independent of display callbacks. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Linux HarfBuzz stays within its bundled implementation** — Binds internal HarfBuzz function calls locally to prevent conflicts when GTK or another library loads a different HarfBuzz globally. Managed signatures and exported entry points are unchanged. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Callbacks use the correct native boolean widths** — Corrects Skia stream, write-stream, and Graphite image-provider callbacks, including Mono ARM64 interpreter behavior, and HarfBuzz font/Unicode callbacks. Public delegates still use bool. False glyph-name callbacks return without copying the name span. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **WASM WebGPU support no longer compiles C++ in application links** — Moves WebGPU port compilation out of the application's final link, avoiding C++ flags on application C sources. JavaScript glue remains a linker input rather than deployed application content. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Valid GLES upload formats** — Ganesh disables BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads that advertise GL_RGBA, a configuration accepted by desktop GL but invalid in GLES. Readback is unchanged. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **SkSL rejects invalid shader programs earlier** — Rejects overflowing raster-pipeline slot counts and reserved invalid runtime-effect types, including struct member types, before later compilation stages. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Disposed front-buffered streams release borrowed references** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. The borrowed stream is not disposed; its caller remains responsible for disposal. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Image pixel copies avoid intermediate SKData** — Valid managed image pixel copies bypass an intermediate SKData allocation. Invalid inputs retain the original path and native validation behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Fewer HarfBuzz encoding and feature-string allocations** — UTF-32 string encoding uses pooled storage, and feature-string conversion avoids a native allocation while preserving decoding semantics, including legacy target frameworks and arbitrary raw tag values. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Updated Windows integration dependencies** — Updates ANGLE to chromium/8118 and the library dependency baseline to Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003, Windows SDK BuildTools 10.0.22621.756, and WebView2 1.0.3179.45. Native source builds move to VS 2026/MSVC v145; the WinUI declared runtime minimum remains Windows 10 build 17763. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
